user_intent: Design a cross-domain, open-source-ready memory system for Rivet's terminal coding agent TUI so the running model becomes stronger over time.

findings: Context type spine already exists: anchors, compacted spans, session sidecar entries, token budget, working set, and context ledger.
AnchorRegistry, proactive injection, PersistentStore, and recall tool exist but are not wired into the production runtime.
Session sidecar entries support manual, compact, and resume sources, but production writes only manual entries.
Worker sessions start with empty context and return results through coordinator aggregation, so parent constraints and durable facts do not propagate yet.
Aider shows the value of readable, diffable history files.
OpenHands shows event-sourced sessions with replay and lazy loading.
Kiro separates persistent resources, session context, and on-demand knowledge bases.
Cursor keeps project rules read-only to the model.
Goose records structured security findings and user allow/deny decisions.
Claude Code re-attaches recently-read files after compaction and keeps large raw outputs on disk with previews.
Synaptic tagging suggests a two-phase path from temporary salience to durable consolidation.
Belady-style cache replacement suggests retaining items likely to be reused, not merely recent items.
CRDT causal clocks suggest deterministic merge metadata for distributed observations, but not automatic truth resolution.
Kafka-style append-only logs with keyed compaction suggest retaining latest state per topic while preserving audit order.
Incident postmortems suggest retained claims need provenance chains and downstream consumers.
Single-file SQLite with WAL is a practical local-first foundation for TypeScript CLI storage.
Append-only event rows plus projection tables give auditability and bounded current views.
sqlite-vec can add same-file vector retrieval later, but scalar and full-text search should ship first.
Structured prompt blocks, input/output separation, and schema validation are required prompt safety boundaries.
Privacy-safe retention needs session-scoped defaults, export/import, path redaction, optional encryption, and retention windows.
Evidence-backed facts can still be stale, scoped, or wrong, so durable entries must remain defeasible claims.
Event sourcing should start narrow, for derived context decisions, not all runtime state.
Local-first truth fragments across machines unless global IDs and export/import are designed first.
XML should be one projection renderer, not the canonical storage format.
The TUI should show anomalies by default, not every lineage edge.
Semantic merge needs conflict journals and adjudication, not blind CRDT convergence.
Quality budgets matter as much as token budgets: contradictions, stale evidence, and unverified promotions must be visible.

synthesis_hypothesis: Rivet should evolve from a session sidecar into a local-first, evidence-backed context organism: temporary anchors become claims, claims survive only through provenance and reuse, projections feed cache-safe prompt layers, and the TUI shows only the mutations, conflicts, and stale facts that need human attention.

variation_candidates.one_liner: A developer records project rules and session notes through explicit commands, and Rivet injects the selected notes into each prompt with a visible budget.
Rivet writes every context-relevant action into a local append-only log, then folds that log into replayable session and project views.
Rivet turns user constraints, tool outcomes, file observations, and verification results into claims that compete for promotion, decay, or quarantine before entering prompt context.
Subagents produce claim proposals with evidence, the coordinator merges compatible observations, and conflicts are surfaced for adjudication instead of silently becoming truth.
Rivet remembers failure patterns, prompt-injection findings, unsafe tool trajectories, and stale assumptions as antibodies that block repeated mistakes.

extinct_as_primary.reason: Manual notes alone do not produce model improvement unless the user curates everything.
Replayability alone does not decide which claims are true or useful.
Semantic facts cannot be resolved by blind CRDT merge without creating false certainty.

survivors.advantage: It directly improves next-turn model behavior while preserving safety through provenance and quality gates.
It converts failures and attacks into protective context, which is the fastest visible improvement for a coding agent.

final_design.name: Evolutionary Context Fabric
first_phase: Wire AnchorRegistry into runtime as ephemeral claim seeds.
Create a narrow local ContextStore for claim events and projections.
Register read-only recall and memory inspection commands.
Inject promoted claims through a provider-rendered context projection.
Show stale, conflicted, and unevidenced promotions in the TUI instead of dumping full lineage.
